1.  **The**: Definite Article (Determiner)
2.  **wind**: Noun (Subject)
3.  **howled**: Verb (Intransitive, Past Tense)
4.  **through**: Preposition
5.  **the**: Definite Article (Determiner)
6.  **trees**: Noun (Object of the Preposition)
7.  **as**: Conjunction (Subordinating)
8.  **the**: Definite Article (Determiner)
9.  **storm**: Noun (Subject of the subordinate clause)
10. **approached**: Verb (Intransitive, Past Tense)
11. **casting**: Verb (Present Participle, functioning as part of a participial phrase modifying the subject "wind")
12. **an**: Indefinite Article (Determiner)
13. **eerie**: Adjective
14. **shadow**: Noun (Direct Object of "casting")
15. **over**: Preposition
16. **the**: Definite Article (Determiner)
17. **small**: Adjective
18. **village**: Noun (Object of the Preposition)
